{{Quote|I'm Lieutenant Bex Kolos, but everyone in Havoc calls me Gearbox. We're a tight unit--you'll like it with us.|Bex Kolos|<ref name="Hit the Ground Running" />}}
'''Bex Kolos''', also known as '''Gearbox''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in [[Havoc Squad]] before defecting to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Considered a longtime personal friend of [[Jace Malcom]],<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopaedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> in [[3643 BBY]], Lieutenant Gearbox was the first of Havoc Squad to receive their new member, a [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|promising sergeant]] newly arrived in [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], briefing him in the basics. After their [[Manka-class armored transport|APC]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] was shot down by [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Separatist]] rockeeters during a separatist [[Battle in Drelliad village|attack]], he tried to repair the walker but failed, later moving on to Fort Garnik.<ref name="Hit the Ground Running" /> He was sent on an unknown mission when the sergeant was sent to help out Havoc member [[Zora]], nicknamed Wraith.

After his [[Separatist War|mission]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], Bex believed that the Republic was becoming too corrupt and decided to [[SpecForce Incident|defect]] in joining the Empire along with [[Harron Tavus]]. He was later present at the [[Separatist stronghold|separatists' base]] when Havoc Squad defected. Prior to his defection, he was the technician for Havoc Squad (later replaced by Yuun). When he joined the Empire, Gearbox started "[[Project B]]" on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] to create a massive assault walker. The trooper pleaded with Gearbox to end this and come back to the Republic, but Bex refused and fought against the Havoc captain. He was defeated and finally came to realize that joining the Empire was his true mistake.


==Behind the scenes==
Bex Kolos is a non-player character from the [[Star Wars video games|massively multi-player online role playing video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is voiced by [[Norm Woodel]].
